{07 00 00}Do you have a second?{01 00 00 05 00}
Because I was wondering if
you'd take a look at this.
{07 14 00}It's a letter from a friend
of mine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Heya{01 07 00}!
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!

A friend of mine sent me a
letter! Here,{07 0b 00} you want to
take a look, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hello there{01 07 00}!
How's life, {04 1f 00}?

{07 14 00}Hey, if you're not in a
hurry, would you take a
look at this, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 0a 00}Oh, I agree. Totally! In
fact, I thought it was
pretty darned good!
But it's not about the
writing.{01 00 00 05 00} It's about the
feelings behind the words.
{07 19 00}All a good letter has to
do is make you feel
special, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 04 00}Really? {01 00 00 0a 00}Wow... {01 01 00}{07 16 00}I guess
everyone sees things
differently, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}I happened to think it was
a very nice letter.

{07 00 00}I guess you must be pretty
well read, huh,
{04 1f 00}?
{07 16 00}It must be hard to make an
impression on someone
like you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}That's really sad.

{07 0b 00}What do you think, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}It gave me a serious case
of the warm fuzzies,
personally, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}I thought it was a bit
strange, to be totally
honest.
{07 0d 00}But that doesn't mean I
didn't totally dig it,
though, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}I just kinda wanted
someone else to gawk at it
too, {04 1f 00}!

{07 0d 00}This letter made me feel
so happy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Not because it really made
any sense or anything.
That's not so important.
{07 14 00}What really counts here is
that my friend meant every
single word written here!
